text: {"answerable": true, "answer": "The passages say SchNet is designed to reflect energy conservation of its predicted force fields [W2726670313#007], but they do not explicitly describe the mechanism. The only related point is that forces obtained as gradients of the total potential energy are conserved by construction, whereas directly predicted forces are not [W4225405705#004]. That contrast is about other models, so the passages do not confirm that SchNet uses this gradient approach."}
